phase8_conclusion: BM25 is the strongest standalone retriever on DEV and holdout; E5 and BGE are materially weaker in aggregate. BGE nevertheless produces complementary top-10 successes missed by BM25 (DEV dense-only = 8; holdout dense-only = 5), so Phase 8 hybrid lexical+dense retrieval is empirically motivated, but improvement over BM25 is not guaranteed.
